scope_note: Scope: these verdicts cover this project's accounts only. A purchase by your spouse or by a corporation you control within 30 days before or after a loss sale also makes it a wash sale (§1091; IRS Pub. 550) — those accounts are not in the project, so check them yourself.

sections.title: WASHED — wash sale (§1091): loss disallowed; no sale undoes it
LOCKED — recent buy; do not sell at a loss
EXITABLE — loss OK only if you exit the FULL position
RISK — sellable now; an IRA still holds (pause IRA buys and dividend reinvestment 30 days after selling)
CLEAR — safe to sell at a loss
